lines.en: label undeservedfuture13:
scene clearnightsky
From that point on, everything is surreal.
lines.zh: 从那一刻起，一切都变得超现实起来。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say it wasn’t already. But the fact that these things that once would have terrified me are now being treated so nonchalantly is...
lines.zh: 倒不是说之前就不超现实。而是这些曾经会把我吓得半死的事情，如今被如此若无其事地对待，这本身就……

lines.en: Well, I don’t really know how to feel.
lines.zh: 嗯，我真不知道该有什么感觉。

lines.en: And I’m trying not to feel much of anything at all for Himawari’s sake since I know she’s working hard right now.
lines.zh: 而我为了 Himawari 尽量不去感受太多——因为我知道她现在正在拼命工作。

lines.en: We move from place to place and girl to girl.
lines.zh: 我们从一个地方挪到另一个地方，从一个女孩挪到下一个女孩。

lines.en: I watch as she rests her hand on each of their heads and rearranges their memories like it’s no more difficult than folding clothes.
lines.zh: 我看着她把手放在她们每个人的头上，重新整理她们的记忆，就像叠衣服一样轻松。

lines.en: And then they just lie there. Dormant. Unconsciously waiting for all of this to blow over when they’ll be picked up like pieces on a chess board and placed wherever it is they’re meant to be.
lines.zh: 然后她们就那么躺着。休眠着。无意识地等着这一切过去，届时她们会像棋盘上的棋子一样被捡起来，放到她们该在的位置上。

lines.en: Then a new game will begin. And I will be the one to make the first move because this world apparently won’t turn at all if I am not the one to start spinning it.
lines.zh: 然后新的一局就会开始。而我会是那个走出第一步的人，因为如果我不是那个开始转动它的人，这个世界显然根本不会运转。

lines.en: At first, each body is a lot like Sana’s. Limp and slumped over at an awkward angle — sometimes propped up against something — but, other times, it’s different.
lines.zh: 起初，每一具身体都很像 Sana 的。瘫软着，以别扭的角度歪倒——有时靠着什么东西——但有时候又不相同。

lines.en: Sometimes, it looks like there was a moment of sentience that somehow penetrated the barrier between where we were and where we are now.
lines.zh: 有时候，看起来像是有一瞬间的意识穿透了我们曾经所在和现在所在之间的屏障。

lines.en: Yasu’s body was covered in scratches.
lines.zh: Yasu 的身体上全是抓痕。

lines.en: Miku had pulled some of her hair out again. I can’t remember the last time she did that.
lines.zh: Miku 又拔掉了一些自己的头发。我都不记得她上一次这样是什么时候了。

lines.en: And then there was Noriko — who’d spent her final moments digging for something so frantically that I thought I caught a glimpse of bone in her fingers before Himawari asked me to look away.
lines.zh: 然后是 Noriko——她最后的时刻在疯狂地挖着什么，我好像瞥见了她指缝里的骨头，直到 Himawari 让我别看。

lines.en: I feel like I could have looked without consequence, though. For this is all too unexpectedly nostalgic for me to let any pain in.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得就算看了也不会怎样。因为这一切意外地让我感到怀念，怀念到我容不下任何痛苦。

lines.en: It reminds me of when I broke through the past on the way to a false future and wound up here of all places — an intermission.
lines.zh: 它让我想起当初我冲破过去、奔向一个虚假的未来，最后却来到了这种地方——一段幕间休息。

lines.en: Or maybe even the type of loading screen you’d get when restarting your favorite game just to find out that the script changed itself and some of your progress carried over.
lines.zh: 或者更像是你重启最爱的游戏时会看到的那种加载画面，只为发现脚本自己改了，而你的部分进度还留了下来。

lines.en: I wonder, if I could read my story again with the knowledge I have now, just how much would change. But I’m not sure I ever will, and that’s not purely because I don’t have the time to.
lines.zh: 我在想，如果我能带着现在这些认知重读一遍我的故事，会有多少东西改变。但我不确定我还能不能做到，而这也不纯粹是因为我没时间。

lines.en: It’s because I am afraid of how I’d see my past self when, for the first time in my life, I am confident that I am doing something right.
lines.zh: 而是因为我害怕看到过去的自己——毕竟这是我人生中第一次确信自己正在做对的事。

lines.en: I watch as Himawari emerges from the room in which we held our traditional “end of the world” party this time. She wouldn’t let me inside.
lines.zh: 我看着 Himawari 从那个房间里出来——我们这次的「世界末日」派对就是在那儿开的。她不让我进去。

lines.en: There’s no curiosity on my end once she’s back in the hall, though. It’s just pride — something I don’t often feel in the ways I should.
lines.zh: 不过她回到走廊后，我心里倒没有好奇。只有骄傲——这是一种我很少以应有的方式去感受的东西。

lines.en: And when I look at her, clearly unperturbed by the horrors she has faced, all I can think of is how strong she is.
lines.zh: 而当我看着她，显然没有被她所面对的那些恐怖影响到，我唯一能想到的就是她有多坚强。

lines.en: And how I am so eternally grateful that she did not grow up to be like me.
lines.zh: 还有，我是多么永远地感激她没有长成我这样的人。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm1
: Okay. So, barring Mom and the girls outside of your class that Shiori is currently hunting for, we’re still missing: Ami, Futaba, Nodoka, and Rin.
lines.zh: : 好的。那么，除了妈妈和 Shiori 正在追的那些不在你班上的女生，我们还缺：Ami、Futaba、Nodoka 和 Rin。

lines.en: : Where did you get a clipboard from? Why aren’t you just using your phone like a normal girl?
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿弄来的写字板？为什么不像个正常女生一样用手机？

lines.en: : This feels more official, obviously. Using my phone would just make it look like I’m texting somebody and I don’t want you thinking I’m irresponsible enough to do that at work.
lines.zh: : 这看起来更正式啊，显然。用手机的话会显得我在跟人发短信，我可不想让你觉得我在上班时间还能那么不负责。

lines.en: : You’ve done plenty today to make me think you’re irresponsible at work. But, despite you breaking so many rules, I do know you’re doing it for me. So I’m very thankful, Himawari.
lines.zh: : 你今天干的事已经够让我觉得你在上班时间不负责了。不过尽管你破了这么多规矩，我知道你都是为了我。所以我非常感激，Himawari。

lines.en: : Well, don’t thank me just yet. We still need to find these stragglers.
lines.zh: : 哎，先别急着谢我。我们还得找到这几个掉队的。

lines.en: : After that, maybe we can stop for lunch somewhere and you can tell me again how awesome I am.
lines.zh: : 在那之后，也许我们可以找个地方吃午饭，你可以再跟我说一遍我有多厉害。

lines.en: : Does your app thing not tell you where they are? I figured you could just...press a button and get their coordinates or something.
lines.zh: : 你那个 app 东西不能告诉你在哪儿吗？我以为你只要……按个按钮就能拿到她们的坐标什么的。

lines.en: : Or am I the only one you have direct surveillance over?
lines.zh: : 还是说我是唯一一个被你直接监视的？

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm2
: I can get the last known location of everyone. But once the clock stops, tracking doesn’t work anymore.
lines.zh: : 我能拿到所有人最后已知的位置。但一旦时钟停止，追踪就不起作用了。

lines.en: : So any movement that occurs subsequent to the events of what you call the “apocalypse” doesn’t register. Which means anyone who moved needs to be tracked down.
lines.zh: : 所以在你所谓的「末日」事件之后发生的任何移动都不会被记录。也就是说，任何移动过的人都需要被找出来。

lines.en: : Normally, this wouldn’t be much of an issue as we’re free to pause and un-pause time as we see fit. But I’m not the one maintaining time here at the moment, so-
lines.zh: : 通常情况下这不算什么大问题，因为我们可以随意暂停和重启时间。但现在这里维持时间的人不是我，所以——

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. Are you saying that all of the girls you just mentioned kept moving around after time stopped? Like what we’re doing now?
lines.zh: : 等等，等一下。你是说你刚才提到的那些女生在时间停止之后还在到处移动？就像我们现在这样？

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm3
: That’s right. That shouldn’t come as that much of a surprise though when you’ve already seen Mom, Maya, and Makoto do it.
lines.zh: : 没错。不过你已经见过妈妈、Maya 和 Makoto 这么做了，应该没那么惊讶吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, notice how none of the girls you’re looking for are on that list? They shouldn’t be able to move at all right now. They should have disappeared.
lines.zh: : 是啊，注意到你找的那几个女生都不在那份名单上了吗？她们现在根本不该能动。她们应该已经消失了。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, nobody really disappears. You just stop seeing them. Like what happened with Maya that one time when you woke up and she was all like “Aaaaaah” and then Mom was like “Woaaaaah.”
lines.zh: : 哦。对，其实没人真的会消失。你只是不再看见她们而已。就像那次 Maya 的事——你一觉醒来，她在那儿「啊啊啊啊」，然后妈妈「哇哦哦哦哦」。

lines.en: : This could be huge, then. Because I can see everyone just fine when you’re here. And if the number of girls who make it to the roof is still expanding, we might be onto something.
lines.zh: : 那这可是个大发现。因为只要你在这儿，我就能清楚地看到所有人。而如果爬上屋顶的女生数量还在增加，我们可能就找到线索了。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm4
: Maybe. But just because they managed to move around after the clock stopped doesn’t mean they’re still moving now. So please don’t get your hopes up.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但她们能在时钟停止后移动，不代表她们现在还在动。所以请别抱太大希望。

lines.en: : I hope you mean that they’re just sitting around waiting and not the other thing that could mean.
lines.zh: : 我希望你说的「希望」是她们正坐着等我们，而不是另一层意思。

lines.en: : It could mean a bunch of things. Waiting. Suicide. Divine interference. Even that someone else moved them. Though, I’m not really sure who would in this case unless Mom is actually evil.
lines.zh: : 这可能意味着很多事。等待。自杀。神的干预。甚至是有人把她们挪走了。不过这次我真想不出会是谁，除非妈妈其实是坏人。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm5
: Oh my god. Imagine she was? And that the only reason she didn’t come with us on our excursion is so she could go sabotage the clean-up crew?
lines.zh: : 哦我的天。想象一下如果真是呢？而她没跟我们一起来这次远足，唯一的原因就是去搞破坏、拖慢清理小组？

lines.en: : I mean...not to add to your conspiracy theory, but she does have a history of custodial murder.
lines.zh: : 我倒不是要给你的阴谋论添砖加瓦，但她确实有「清洁工式谋杀」的前科。

lines.en: : Then time is even more pressing, Dad. You don’t have any idea where any of those girls would be, do you?
lines.zh: : 那时间就更紧迫了，爸爸。你完全不知道那些女生会在哪儿，对吧？

lines.en: : If Ami and Nodoka aren’t here, I don’t really know where they would be. But Rin and Futaba went back to the dorms from what I understand.
lines.zh: : 如果 Ami 和 Nodoka 不在这儿，我真不知道她们会在哪儿。不过据我所知，Rin 和 Futaba 回宿舍了。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm6
: Did they? Then why are they still marked off as being at the inn?
lines.zh: : 是吗？那为什么她们还被标记为在旅馆？

lines.en: : I...don’t know. I remember them leaving, though. Right after Futaba went on a massive, uncharacteristic tirade about the nature of the world and how much of a douchebag I am.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道。不过我记得她们走了。就在 Futaba 发表了一大段极不符合她性格的、关于世界本质的长篇大论，以及我是个多大的混蛋之后。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm7
: And you didn’t think that “massive uncharacteristic tirade about the nature of the world” was something worth mentioning? Just gonna keep that info in your back pocket?
lines.zh: : 而你没觉得「一大段极不符合她性格的、关于世界本质的长篇大论」是值得一提的事？就这么把情报揣兜里了？

lines.en: : You could at least get mad about her calling me a douchebag.
lines.zh: : 你至少可以为她骂我混蛋这件事生下气吧。

lines.en: : I’m about to call you a douchebag too for concealing relevant information from a divine official. I hope you have a lawyer ready.
lines.zh: : 我正要因为你对一位神职人员隐瞒相关情报而骂你混蛋呢。希望你律师准备好了。

lines.en: : I have two now, actually. I’ll see you in court.
lines.zh: : 我现在有两个了，其实。法庭上见。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm8
: Sorry — trial’s in recess.
lines.zh: : 抱歉——休庭。

lines.en: : But it hasn’t even started yet.
lines.zh: : 可还没开庭呢。

lines.en: : Come on. Take my hand again. We’ll go check the dorms and see if they’re still around. After that, though, we need to make finding Ami a priority. She can be a troublesome one.
lines.zh: : 走了。再牵着我的手。我们去宿舍看看她们还在不在。不过在那之后，我们得把找 Ami 当成首要任务。她可能是个麻烦角色。

lines.en: : What? What is that supposed to-
lines.zh: : 什么？那是什么意思——

lines.en: : I’d rather you find out from her and not me. But that’s info for later. Come, Father. Hold your daughter’s hand in this dark and scary world. She requires your protection.
lines.zh: : 我更希望你是从她那儿知道的，而不是从我这儿。不过那是以后的情报了。来吧，父亲。在这个又黑又可怕的世界里牵着你女儿的手。她需要你的保护。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm9
: Okay...But if I don’t find out from her-
lines.zh: : 好吧……但如果我没能从她那儿知道——

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’ll tell you myself if I have to. I promise I won’t leave until you know.
lines.zh: : 别担心。如果非说不可，我会亲口告诉你的。我保证在你弄明白之前不会离开。

lines.en: : I wish you’d just promise to not leave at all.
lines.zh: : 我倒希望你保证的是根本不离开。

lines.en: : So do I. And one day, I will.
lines.zh: : 我也希望如此。总有一天，我会的。

lines.en: : But for now...
lines.zh: : 但现在……

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm10
: Our scavenger hunt continues!
lines.zh: : 我们的寻宝继续！

lines.en: : I hope you’re ready to find even more body parts this time. Horseface Taki’s Power Hour continues now.
lines.zh: : 希望你准备好这次能找到更多身体部位。Horseface Taki 的 Power Hour 现在继续。

lines.en: : Have you actually met him or is he just a thing I made up that you know about for some reason?
lines.zh: : 你是真见过他，还是他只是我编出来的、你不知为何知道的东西？

lines.en: : He’s real. Just a lesser god though. Doesn’t even show up on the popularity polls.
lines.zh: : 他是真的。不过只是个次级神。连人气投票都上不了。

lines.en: : You have popularity polls?
lines.zh: : 你们还有人气投票？

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm11
: Oh, totally. It’s a great way to farm engagement and acquire new customers. You’ll see ads for them on TV and everything if we ever get you out of here.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然有。这是刷互动、拉新客户的好办法。等我们把你弄出去，你在电视上都能看到它们的广告什么的。

lines.en: : I’m not sure I want to leave anymore. I don’t even like seeing them in my dreams. I don’t need them infiltrating reality.
lines.zh: : 我都不确定我还想不想走了。我连在梦里看到它们都不喜欢。我可不需要它们渗透进现实。

lines.en: : I mean, technically speaking, it’s us who infiltrated reality. Most of the gods predate us by, like...zillions of years. In the context of this world, though, I get what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，是我们渗透进了现实才对。大多数神比我们早了……嗯……几亿亿年。不过在这个世界的语境下，我懂你的意思。

lines.en: : It’s probably not as bad as you think, though. With so many gods offering different things for different individuals, it gives almost everyone something to believe in.
lines.zh: : 不过大概没你想的那么糟。那么多神为不同的人提供不同的东西，几乎每个人都能找到可以信仰的东西。

lines.en: : And having them work alongside humans did a lot to build trust between them and the people. So it’s not really anything like the way it is here.
lines.zh: : 而且让他们和人类并肩工作，对他们和人们之间建立信任大有帮助。所以跟这儿的情况完全不一样。

lines.en: : So they’re not only reaching out to people for their own benefit now?
lines.zh: : 所以他们现在不只是在为了自己的利益接触人类？

lines.en: : They are. They need to in order to keep existing. But it’s a mostly symbiotic relationship that emphasizes mutual benefit rather than just one party’s gain.
lines.zh: : 是。他们必须这么做才能继续存在。不过这基本上是共生关系，强调的是互利，而不是单方面的获利。

lines.en: : There will always be bad actors, of course. Some gods still act more like snake-oil salesmen than divine figures.
lines.zh: : 当然，总会有坏家伙。有些神的做派还是更像卖狗皮膏药的，而不是什么神明。

lines.en: : But the world has caught on and they’re the ones fizzling out now. Especially since most of them lack professional representation.
lines.zh: : 但世人已经看穿了，现在正在消散的反而是他们。尤其是因为他们大多数都没有专业的经纪公司。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm12
: Can’t help but feel bad for all the atheists out there, though. Like, damn. Egg on your face. They’re basically just the new version of flat-earthers.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是忍不住替外面的无神论者难过。唉，真是打脸。他们基本上就是新时代的地平说信徒了。

lines.en: : I honestly can’t tell if any of this is legitimate or if it’s just another mahjong situation.
lines.zh: : 我真说不好这些到底是不是真的，还是又一场麻将事件。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm13
: Believe whatever you want to believe. That’s the prevailing and accepted stance now. But, if it’s cool, I have a question for you, Dad.
lines.zh: : 你爱信什么信什么。现在流行且被接受的就是这个立场。不过，如果可以的话，我有个问题想问你，爸爸。

lines.en: : Me? Sure. What is it?
lines.zh: : 问我？当然。什么问题？

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm14
: Isn’t there supposed to be more “dorm” there?
lines.zh: : 那儿不该有更多「宿舍」吗？

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm15
: There probably should be, yeah.
lines.zh: : 应该是吧，嗯。

lines.en: : How do you even get up here without teleportation?
lines.zh: : 不用传送的话你到底怎么上来的？

lines.en: : There’s a lot about this building that doesn’t make any sense. We’ve all just sort of tuned it out, I think.
lines.zh: : 这栋楼有很多地方都说不通。我想我们都已经习惯性忽略了。

lines.en: : Sure. But really, though. How the hell do you get up here?
lines.zh: : 好吧。但说真的。你到底是怎么上来的？

lines.en: : You’re the one with a live-feed of my existence. Just tune in one day and find out for yourself.
lines.zh: : 你可是有我存在的实时画面的。哪天自己调出来看看不就知道了。

lines.en: : I think I’d rather just not know than remove the dorms from my blacklist. I know what goes on here.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿永远不知道，也不想把宿舍从我的黑名单里移除。我知道这儿都发生了些什么。

lines.en: : On that note, you are forbidden from ever staying in any dorm. I want you to remember that even if I don’t wind up escaping.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你被禁止住在任何宿舍里。就算我最后没能逃出去，你也得记住这一点。

lines.en: : That’s fine. It’d be harder recording all of my ASMR videos with a roommate anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正有室友的话，我录 ASMR 视频也更费劲。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm16
: You will escape, though. And I don’t want you to even acknowledge the possibility of that not happening.
lines.zh: : 不过你会逃出去的。而且我不许你哪怕去想那不发生的可能。

lines.en: : You’re putting a lot of faith in me, Himawari. I needed to have my hand held both literally and figuratively to find out literally any of this.
lines.zh: : 你对我寄予了太多信心，Himawari。我需要你手把手——字面和比喻意义上都是——才能弄明白这里的任何一件事。

lines.en: : Maya didn’t know either and she did this for thousands if not millions of years. How can I find a way out if I don’t even know where I am? Or what else exists?
lines.zh: : Maya 也不知道，而她做这件事做了几千年甚至几百万年。如果我连自己在哪儿、还有什么存在都不知道，怎么可能找到出去的路？

lines.en: : You know I exist.
lines.zh: : 你知道我存在。

lines.en: : And if I found you, I know you can find me too.
lines.zh: : 而如果我能找到你，我就知道你也能找到我。

lines.en: : You have a clear advantage as a time and dimension-hopping divine custodian. I’m little more than a clone of my imaginary girlfriend’s desires.
lines.zh: : 你作为一个能穿越时间和维度的神圣清洁工，优势明显。我无非是我那个想象中的女友的欲望的复制品。

lines.en: : You’re no clone, Dad. You’re the real thing. You were just dragged somewhere you were never meant to be, and now we’re going to take you home.
lines.zh: : 你不是复制品，爸爸。你是真的。你只是被拖到了一个你本不该在的地方，而现在我们要带你回家。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm17
: But, in order to do that, we must first find the rest of your harem! Futaba and Rin are in Dorm 4, right?
lines.zh: : 不过，为了做到这一点，我们必须先找到你后宫的其余成员！Futaba 和 Rin 在四号宿舍，对吧？

lines.en: : Right. But, if Rin is in there, don’t make eye contact with her. I don’t want her falling in love with you.
lines.zh: : 对。不过如果 Rin 在里面，别跟她对视。我可不想让她爱上你。

lines.en: : I’ll take one for the team if it means giving Mom an advantage. Maybe Futaba will fall in love with me too and I’ll have knocked two competitors off the list at once?
lines.zh: : 如果能让妈妈多点优势，我愿意为团队牺牲一次。也许 Futaba 也会爱上我，那我就一次干掉两个竞争对手了？

lines.en: : Or they’re just not in there and none of this will matter.
lines.zh: : 或者她们根本不在里面，那这些都无所谓。

lines.en: : Only one way to find out, I guess. Please hold while I investigate.
lines.zh: : 我想只有一个办法能知道。请稍等，我去查一下。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm18
scene himagoestothedorm19
scene himagoestothedorm18
scene himagoestothedorm20
: Yeah. Doesn’t look like they’re here.
lines.zh: : 嗯。看起来她们不在这儿。

lines.en: : Really? Maybe the coffee shop Rin works at then? I can see her going there in the event of an apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那也许是 Rin 打工的那家咖啡店？我能想象世界末日的时候她会去那儿。

lines.en: : I’ll just ask Shi-chan to keep an eye out for them so we can get to looking for Ami.
lines.zh: : 我会让 Shi 酱帮忙留意她们，我们好先去找 Ami。

lines.en: scene himagoestothedorm21
: Her dorm is just across the hall. I doubt she’s in there, though. I imagine she would have come out the second she heard my voice if she was.
lines.zh: : 她的宿舍就在走廊对面。不过我怀疑她不在里面。我想她要是听见我的声音，早就冲出来了。

lines.en: scene black
: Want to check yourself while I make a quick phone call?
lines.zh: : 想趁我打个简短的电话的时候自己去看看吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Yeah, I can do that. It’ll also give me time to warn her that you aren’t a threat. That’s a thing I need to do with her now.
lines.zh: : 嗯？好，我可以。这样我也能有时间提醒她你不是威胁。现在这正是我需要对她做的事。

lines.en: : Works for me! Be right back! And don’t fall off the ledge!
lines.zh: : 正合我意！马上回来！别从阳台边上掉下去！

lines.en: : Oh, that reminds me. There’s another ledge I found with Io that-
lines.zh: : 哦，这倒提醒我了。我和 Io 还发现了另一处阳台——

lines.en: : Hold that thought! Phone is ringing!
lines.zh: : 先记着！电话响了！
